description: 🦆🧠 Give your small robot a brain. Tell a Microduck, an Open Duck Mini you built yourself, a Reachy Mini, a LeRobot arm or any ROS base what you want in human language. An LLM (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, or a local model via Ollama, vLLM or llama.cpp) uses the skills it already has. Simulator, .duck task files, MCP, memory between runs, flocks.
